html:
The Ngardi are an Aboriginal people of the Tanami Desert, on both sides of the border between the Northern Territory and Western Australia.

Their language is close to that of the Warlpiri, their neighbours to the east. Other neighbours were the Kukatja to the west and the Jaru and Gurindji to the north. In the 1900s many Ngardi people moved to Balgo, Lajamanu and other settlements, and some became painters in the desert art movement. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Ngardi are an Aboriginal people of the Tanami Desert, on both sides of the border between the Northern Territory and Western Australia.
